text:
elaine: heads-up — we need to lock a go/no-go for the cut window on Wed 03/31 22:00 UTC (off-hours).
elaine: trying to assemble primary + two backups, canary owners, and infra lead. please add availability below or fill the poll: https://poll.example.com/3xk2 (quick) :spiral_calendar:
elaine: draft agenda + quick preflight checklist pasted below — feedback welcome. cc @marc @priya @jon
marc: I can be primary for the gate if it's off-hours, but i need a backup after 23:00 UTC — traveling earlier in the evening. :+1:
priya: I can be backup until 23:30 UTC and do the post-canary smoke if needed. happy to own canary metrics dashboard. :eyes:
jon: i'll take canary owner, will run the manual smoke tests and hold the rollback decision if issues.
riley: infra lead — i'll prep the KV cache warmup playbook and confirm access. will add runbook links to the doc.
sam: I can be second backup (overnight), prefer not to be primary.
arjun: can volunteer for post-cut health checks (1h post).
deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy plan created by elaine at https://redwood.internal/deploys/1765432100 — runbook attached.
elaine: thanks all. agenda template (copy into the deploy doc):
elaine: ```
- 22:00 - Gate open: rollcall (owners + backups)
- 22:05 - Quick sanity checks (infra, network, auth) - infra lead
- 22:10 - Canary push (10% traffic) - canary owner
- 22:25 - Canary metrics review (p95 latency, error rates, business signals)
- 22:35 - Decide: promote / hold / rollback
- 22:45 - If promote: full rollout plan + throttles
- 23:00 - Post-cut health checks (1h cadence checks)
- 23:30 - Handoff notes + incident channels + next 2 backups confirmed
```
priya: tiny nit — include a step to verify KV cache priming for common prefixes (that reduced cold-starts last time).
elaine: good call, added step at 22:03.
marc: added my backup (sam) in the poll.
sam: confirmed in poll — can cover 22:00-02:00 UTC.
arjun: linking the smoke checklist I'll use: https://redwood.internal/checks/smoke-shortlist (will paste required queries into the deploy doc).
riley: runbook links added: infra/kvs-warmup, infra/net-health, infra/failover-steps. please verify perms.
jon: quick ask — do we want a short postmortem template if the gate triggers a rollback? happy to own it.
elaine: yes, please create a 1-page rollback PM template in the deploy doc (jon takes it).
priya: one more: can someone volunteer to watch business signals (billing/ingest) during canary? i'm focused on app metrics.
marc: @jon can you watch biz signals? you said you'd handle rollback.
jon: can do biz signals too.
elaine: final roster so far: primary=marc, backup1=priya, backup2=sam, canary=jon, infra=riley, post-cut=arjun.
elaine: if anyone else wants to be added, reply here. otherwise i'll mark the gate as staffed and update the deploy plan in 30m. :white_check_mark:
priya: LGTM
marc: looks good :thumbsup:
sam: good to go
jon: noted, will prepare rollback template and metrics dashboard links
elaine: updated deploy doc and calendar invite. Thanks everyone — closing thread and will ping mitigations channel 30m before gate. :rocket:
